chain_words.nuance: fairly big and noticeable, but not extreme
very big, much bigger than usual
exceptionally big, almost beyond normal expectations

explanation: These words all describe size, but they rise in intensity from a moderately big size to an extraordinarily big one. Advertisers often choose stronger words like huge or enormous to make a product seem impressive.

usage_notes.difference: 'Large' describes something bigger than average; 'huge' is stronger and suggests something much bigger than expected.
